**Current state:** OPEN and PAUSED; no later acceptance receipt was established by this shutdown capture. The October11 clause assessment remains the prior boundary; any dated runtime/telemetry facts in it require refresh on resume.

**Prior clause assessment (October11, not a new runtime probe):** Retained handoff reports real outdoor replay corpus still lacksHUMIDIFY coverage. Live outdoor/forecast values are fresh but do not prove corpus fresh/stale branches, no future leakage and known-good replay qualification.

**Blockers:** Jason explicitly paused all implementation/delivery. The listed acceptance boundary remains unproved beyond linked historical receipts.

**Next step on explicit resume:** After explicit Jason resume, refresh exact source/live and predecessor evidence, then satisfy: Corpus contains measured finite outdoor age with provenance and both fresh/stale branches; a zero-coverage corpus fails loudly.

**Acceptance retained:**
- [ ] Corpus contains measured finite outdoor age with provenance and both fresh/stale branches; a zero-coverage corpus fails loudly.
- [ ] No future outdoor sample leaks into replay; missing values preserve safe stale behavior.
- [ ] Native/invariant/band and targeted outdoor tests pass against the candidate and known-good self-diff.
